interpretation.presence: For Si only, Yin and Shen are supplied by day/month, qualified actual motion or an actual own transformation. Explicit motion is a structural presence, not a claim of usable harmful action. Unresolved dark activity leaves presence unknown; static labels and other-parent transformations are not borrowed.
interpretation.growth: At Yin day, a matched scoped triad excludes both the same Yin day growth and its ordinary wood-generation credit. A pending triad leaves that credit pending. Other independent support, raw element relation and original stage position remain.
interpretation.effect: Triad presence does not prove injury, weakness, total loss of generation, a clinical event or any real-world outcome. Keep an explicitly unresolved opposition and keep unsupported-controlled-source false from being inferred solely from it.
interpretation.scope: Only Si-Yin-Shen and the stated original growth exclusion; no complete punishment table or novel count, strength vote, global precedence or outcome rule.
